prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity mobile web app north-star composition, portrait 393x852
Primary request: Design the first-use Scan screen for LifeGoods, a Khmer-first packaged-food evidence guide. Composition C is evidence-led: the Open Label identity appears as three aligned paper-label layers in the header; the camera consent area visually explains the sequence Scan package → Read declared concerns → Inspect source without using numbered steps or separate cards. The actual camera aperture remains the focal element, followed by a full-width Start camera action and a Search by Product or barcode row. Fixed five-tab navigation ordered History, Learn, Scan, Search, Concerns with Scan dominant in the center.
Style/medium: production-ready mobile app UI mockup, not a poster and not a phone-device frame; combines friendly product photography hierarchy with neutral privacy/evidence clarity.
Typography: bold friendly sans, Khmer-safe line height, strong black headings and restrained metadata.
Color palette: warm white #FAFAF7, charcoal #17181A, cool gray #6F747B and #D9DDE2, indigo #3658D4, limited mango #F2B84B for identity and scan emphasis.
Materials: flat label-paper layers, thin dividers, modest 12-16px radii on controls only, no shadows except a soft camera control lift.
Text (verbatim): "LifeGoods", "Scan the label. See the evidence.", "Your camera stays private.", "Start camera", "Search by Product or barcode", "History", "Learn", "Scan", "Search", "Concerns".
Constraints: one dominant camera action, no score, no colored verdict, no red-green indicator, no positive/negative labels, no health verdict, no recommendation, no gradients, no glass, no card stack, no phone frame, no watermark.
